property.name: Aurelia Sanctuary
property.tagline: A secluded modernist retreat nestled above the highland valley

spaces.name: Estate Exterior & Approach
spaces.description: Monolithic brutalist facade perched on the mountain slope, framed by native Saguaro cacti and expansive desert canyon vistas.

spaces.name: Entrance Canopy & Water Channel
spaces.description: Architectural timber overhang spanning a linear black-tile reflection pool, anchored by mature desert palms and massive vertical pivot doors.

spaces.name: Sunken Living Lounge
spaces.description: Expansive central gathering pavilion featuring a bespoke modular conversation pit, acoustic wood plank ceiling, and dual-aspect floor-to-ceiling glass.

spaces.name: Gourmet Kitchen & Dining Island
spaces.description: Open culinary workspace with bookmatched Calacatta marble waterfall island, minimalist bronze barstools, and integrated dark cabinetry.

spaces.name: Central Gallery Corridor
spaces.description: Symmetrical architectural transit corridor with linear vertical slot lighting leading from the public lounge toward the private master suite.

spaces.name: Master Bedroom Suite
spaces.description: Secluded primary bedroom sanctuary framed by dual-aspect panoramic glass, featuring a low platform king bed, integrated walnut headboard, and tranquil desert mountain outlooks.

visual.alt: Aurelia Sanctuary Master Bedroom Suite with platform king bed and panoramic desert windows

spaces.name: Primary Ensuite Spa
spaces.description: Architectural bathroom sanctuary boasting a monolithic freestanding stone soaking tub overlooking an enclosed private cactus meditation courtyard, double walnut vanity, and frameless rainfall shower.

visual.alt: Aurelia Sanctuary Primary Ensuite Bathroom featuring freestanding stone soaking tub and private desert courtyard

spaces.name: Cantilevered Infinity Pool & Terrace
spaces.description: Zero-edge dark basalt infinity pool cantilevered directly over the canyon contour, flanked by honed limestone sun decks, minimalist teak loungers, and 270-degree sunset mountain panoramas.

visual.alt: Aurelia Sanctuary Cantilevered Infinity Pool and Sun Terrace overlooking desert canyon at sunset
